LanguageData.LP_Sub_EldritchKnight.label: Eldritch Knight
LanguageData.LP_Sub_EldritchKnight.description: Sword and sorcery. Has their own mana (max 1 + fighter level ÷ 3, recovered by sleep and research, slowly regained while awake too), used for war cantrips; the bound weapon can't be disarmed and can be summoned back to the hand.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiWarrior.label: Psi Warrior
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiWarrior.description: Fight with the power of the mind. With a psylink, abilities cost no grit and add neural heat instead (costing grit as usual when neural heat can't take it); without a psylink they only cost grit. Effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hemomancy.label: School of Hemomancy
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hemomancy.description: Blood instead of mana: hemomancy spells don't cost mana but make you lose blood (can't cast once blood loss reaches 45%; vampires spend hemogen instead). The more you're hurt yourself, the higher the hemomancy damage (up to +30%). Liches and the undead have no blood and can't choose it.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_AberrantMind.label: Aberrant Mind
LanguageData.LP_Sub_AberrantMind.description: The shadow of a mind flayer lies in the blood: calm colonists having breaks, hurt enemies with psionic spikes, grow tentacles, and finally dominate an enemy to serve you.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Conquest.label: Oath of Conquest
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Conquest.description: Rule through fear. Channel Oath once per day (twice at level 11, three times at 15), no divinity cost. Tenet: don't release prisoners; when the colony releases a prisoner the oath is broken (for 1 day divinity recovery halved and Channel Oath unusable; a third break within 1 day adds mood -10).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Redemption.label: Oath of Redemption
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Redemption.description: Make peace to end war. Channel Oath once per day (twice at level 11, three times at 15), no divinity cost. Tenet: never personally kill a downed person, prisoner or slave (executions count); violating it breaks the oath (for 1 day divinity recovery halved and Channel Oath unusable; a third break within 1 day adds mood -10).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DraconicSoul.label: Draconic Soul
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DraconicSoul.description: The soul of a true dragon flows in the blood: dragon blood at level 4 (Constitution +2), dragon wings at 10 (walking ignores terrain), dragon fear at 14 (a frightful presence like a true dragon's that can frighten enemies and make them panic and flee).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.label: Fiendish Blood
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.description: Cage the fiend of your bloodline within your body, trading max mana for body enhancements: eyes (Charisma), skin (turns red, faster wound healing and continuous regeneration), tongue (psychic sensitivity). Each enhancement turned on reduces sorcerer max mana by 2. At level 4 only 1 can be on at once; at level 8 you can have 2 on and enhancement effects double; at level 12 pick one to fix permanently (always on, not counting toward the limit, not reducing mana), with the other two maintained as usual.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.choices.0.label: permanently fixed enhancement
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.choices.0.tips.0: Charisma +4, always on, doesn't reduce max mana.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.choices.0.tips.1: Skin turns red, wound healing ×2 with continuous regeneration, always on, doesn't reduce max mana.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_FiendBlood.choices.0.tips.2: Psychic sensitivity +60%, always on, doesn't reduce max mana.
